spans.s:
f. (-का)
One of the courtezans of Svarga, and wife to Himālaya.
E.
मे to me, का any one, न not, (equal or comparable.)

f. (-जा)
DURGĀ or PĀRVATĪ.
E.
मेनका the wife of the personified Himālaya mountain, and आत्मजा daughter.

m. (-शः)
The personified Himālaya mountain.
E.
मेनका the Apsaras so named, and प्राणेश husband.

f. (-ना)
The wife of Himālaya; see मेनका.

f. (-जा)
PĀRVATĪ.
E.
मेना for मेनका the mother of the goddess, and जा born.

m. (-दः)
1 A cat.
2 A goat.
3 A peacock.
E.
मे imitative cry, mew, and नाद sound.

m. (-वः)
Himālaya, the personified mountain, and father of DURGĀ, as PĀRVATĪ.
E.
मेना the wife of the mountain, and धव husband.

f. (-न्धी)
A plant, from the leaves of which a reddish dye is prepared, with which the palms of the hands, tips of the fingers, soles of the feet, and finger nails are stained, (Lawsonia inermis); also मेन्धिका.
